news.snippet: SK hynix Inc., the world’s largest supplier of HBM memory, today filed to list i...
news.raw_snippet: SK hynix Inc., the world’s largest supplier of HBM memory, today filed to list its shares on the Nasdaq stock exchange. SK hynix produces more than half of the world’s HBM memory, the fast, pricey RAM that artificial intelligence chips use to store data. As a result, data can move more quickly between an HBM device and the processor to which it’s attached. The technology is particularly useful for AI models because they move data between the host processor’s logic circuits and memory more often than most other applications. SK hynix’s leadership position in the HBM market can be partly credited to its portfolio of thermal management technologies. HBM modules generate significantly more heat than a standard DRAM chip, which can cause malfunctions in the graphics card to which they’re attached. As the parent company of SiliconANGLE, theCUBE Network, theCUBE Research, CUBE365, theCUBE AI and theCUBE SuperStudios — with flagship locations in Silicon Valley and the New York Stock Exchange — SiliconANGLE Media operates at the intersection of media, technology and AI.

news.title: AI Capital Strategy: IPOs, CapEx and the Race to Fund Compute
news.snippet: HomeBlogAI Capital Strategy: IPOs, CapEx and the Race to Fund Compute. AI Capita...
news.raw_snippet: HomeBlogAI Capital Strategy: IPOs, CapEx and the Race to Fund Compute. AI Capital Strategy: IPOs, CapEx and the Race to Fund Compute. Explore how AI companies are using IPOs, CapEx, cloud contracts, private capital and energy deals to fund the compute infrastructure behind frontier AI. **AI capital strategy** is the way frontier AI companies fund the compute infrastructure needed to train and run advanced models. It includes IPOs, CapEx, debt, cloud contracts, GPU supply agreements, data centers, power procurement and private infrastructure financing. The biggest AI companies are now competing for physical compute, massive GPU clusters, multi-gigawatt data centers, secure power grids, and the long-term capital required to finance them all. In this deep dive, we explore how AI has transitioned from an asset-light software business into a heavy-industry capital race, why CapEx is the new competitive moat, and what this structural shift means for enterprise IT, investors, and the global cloud ecosystem.

news.title: Orange Appoints Usman Javaid as Chief AI Officer to Drive Artificial Intelligence Transformation
news.snippet: # Orange Appoints Usman Javaid as Chief AI Officer to Drive Artificial Intellige...
news.raw_snippet: # Orange Appoints Usman Javaid as Chief AI Officer to Drive Artificial Intelligence Transformation. Orange Appoints Usman Javaid as Chief AI Officer to Drive Artificial Intelligence Transformation  Image Credit: Orange. Orange announced the appointment of Usman Javaid as the Group's Chief AI Officer, effective from 1 September 2026. Reporting directly to Bruno Zerbib, the Group's Chief Technology & Innovation Officer, Usman Javaid will be responsible for accelerating and scaling up Orange's AI initiatives, building on the strong technological foundations already in place. In particular, he will aim to embed AI and agentic AI at the heart of Orange's operations, across networks, customer relations, operations and services for businesses. With its Trust the future strategy, presented in February 2026, Orange has made artificial intelligence a major driver of value creation, serving quality of service, operational excellence, customer experience and the development of new growth opportunities.
